initial_state: Original mixed-sign eddies, balanced for Omega=4.5; no restart from the Omega=3 dipole and no ramp.
unchanged_physics: Same heating, cap/cooling, SGS dissipation, transport, periodic horizontal and impermeable stress-free vertical boundaries as the original seeded pair.
validation_change: Peak density departure exceeds the old 0.75 small-perturbation heuristic; it is reported as a warning. Initialized fields are unchanged by this reporting adjustment. Positivity, stable cap, near-neutral bulk, discrete balance, mass/KE matching, output and restart checks are mandatory.

cpu_validation.density_departure_gate: Old amplitude heuristic reported, not enforced; positivity, stable cap, near-neutral bulk, discrete force balance and exact restart remain mandatory
cpu_validation.scope: Original mixed-sign velocity field at constant Omega=4.5; balanced thermodynamic initialization, full-vector Coriolis, actual driver output and restart

balance.note: Finite-amplitude mixed-sign flow; mass and kinetic energy matched; pressure/density and balanced thermal/potential energy differ for rotation-dependent balance. No mature thermal parent.

energy_policy: Warning-only energy residual; existing finite-state, positivity, mass, Mach and timestep guards retained.
output: Three-depth vorticity and tracer every time unit; checkpoint every 10; full fields every 20.
control: Separate existing Omega=3 continuation remains at Omega=3 throughout. The previously proposed ramp branch was cancelled.
